Visszakapom a kauciót?: Will I get my deposit back?
Igen. A kaució nem bérleti díj, hanem bi: Yes. The deposit is not a rental fee but a security. After the car has been returned and any open damage or fine cases have been settled, we transfer back the full remaining amount after the deductions permitted under the contract, within {1} days at the latest.

Nem. A kaució nem kamatozik, és nem szám: No. The deposit does not earn interest and is not counted towards the rental fee — it serves as security for the entire rental period.

Igen, egyes bérleteknél az induláskor ne: Yes, for some rentals no deposit is payable at the start. Nem. A kár, az önrész, a biztosítás álta: No. Damage, the excess, damage not covered by insurance, fines and excess mileage are borne by the renter even if the amount exceeds the deposit or if no deposit is available.

Töréskár esetén a kár {1}%-a, lopás és r: For accident damage, {1}% of the damage; for theft and robbery, {2}% — but in both cases at least {3} € per incident.

{1} full months from handover. After that, the contract continues indefinitely on the same terms and can be terminated with {2} days’ notice to the end of a rental month — or you can switch to another car.
